title: O Castelo de Pambre, historical novel by Antonio López Ferreiro (1895), Galician Wikisource
period: 19th century (1895), literary Galician in pre-standard spelling (set in 1378); the modern descendant of medieval Galician-Portuguese
notes: License: the 1895 novel is public domain (author d. 1910); the Wikisource page (pinned revision 21789) is published under Wikisource's terms, CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Policy:Terms_of_Use). The url pins a fixed page revision (oldid), so the bytes do not change. 256,226 bytes; wikitext; a header template, one image link and a few div tags add a few dozen Latin letters, negligible. vs/refcorpus.normalize(..., 'galician') gives 243,267 characters. Proxy for the Galician-Portuguese leg of Cheshire's proto-Romance proposal (step K-016-open-2), next to the Catalan pin (C-002) and the pending modern Portuguese corpus (M-J-portuguese).
